Veyra Privacy Policy

Last updated: 18 October 2026

Veyra is a private place to keep moments, photos and letters. It is made by Hjalmar Mauria Nilsson and published by Kim Mauria Jørgensen, Denmark ("we"). This policy explains what Veyra keeps, why, and what you can do about it.

The short version: what you keep in Veyra is yours and only yours. There are no ads, no tracking, no analytics, no followers and no public profiles. We never sell your data. Nobody sees your moments unless you send one to someone.

What Veyra keeps

Your account

  • Your email address and a password (the password is stored only as a secure hash; we can't read it).
  • Your name, as you typed it when you signed up.

What you create

  • Moments: their title, your words, the day, and any photos you add.
  • Letters to your future self: the title, your words, an optional photo, and the day the letter opens. Until that day the letter is sealed: the app does not show it, not even to you.
  • Adventures: their name, the country and when they started and ended.
  • Small settings that follow your account, such as season films you saved and which milestones you've already seen.

When you send something to someone

When you send a moment, an adventure, a look-back or a letter by link, Veyra saves a copy of it (its words, your first name and copies of its photos) for the person who opens the link. Only that one person can open it, and an unopened link stops working after 30 days. A letter sent this way stays sealed for them until the day you chose. What you send is a copy: changing or deleting the original doesn't change their copy. If you delete your account, everything you sent is deleted too.

When you invite friends

Veyra gives you a short invite code. If a friend uses it when they join, we keep a note that they joined with your code, so we can count how many friends joined and give you the discount. You only ever see the number, never who. Deleting either account deletes the note.

What Veyra does not collect

  • No location tracking. The country of an adventure is the one you choose.
  • No contacts, no camera, no microphone. Veyra only sees the photos you pick.
  • No advertising identifiers, no analytics, no third-party tracking.
  • Reminders ("A memory came back today") are worked out and scheduled on your phone; nothing is sent to us to decide them.

Why we keep it

Only to run Veyra for you: to sign you in, to keep what you create safe and in sync across your devices, to deliver what you send to the person you send it to, and to send the emails you need (your sign-up code and password reset).

The legal basis is that we need it to provide the app you signed up for (the performance of our contract with you, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).

Who helps us run Veyra

These services process data on our behalf, only to provide Veyra:

  • Supabase: stores your account, what you create and your photos (in the United Kingdom, London).
  • Google (Gmail): sends Veyra's emails (it receives your email address).
  • Expo: delivers app updates (it receives standard technical information such as your IP address and app version, not your content).
  • Apple and Google: deliver the app, handle Veyra's subscription payments (we never see your card details, only whether you have a subscription) and, if you allow notifications, show Veyra's reminders.

Some of these services are outside the EU (Supabase's servers are in the United Kingdom; Google, Expo and Apple are American companies). Your data is protected there by the EU's adequacy decisions for the United Kingdom and for the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, or by the EU's standard contractual clauses.

We don't share your data with anyone else, except if the law requires it.

How long we keep it

As long as you have an account. When you delete something, it's deleted. When you delete your account, everything is deleted: your account, moments, letters, adventures, photos and anything you sent. Copies in our storage provider's backups, if any, are removed automatically within 30 days.

Your choices and rights

  • See and download everything: Profile → "Your memories are yours" → Download my memories.
  • Change it: edit or delete any moment; change your name in Profile.
  • Delete your account: Profile → Delete account. It can't be undone.
  • Notifications: turn reminders off in Profile or in your phone's settings.
  • Your rights under the GDPR: you can ask us to access, correct, delete or hand over your data, or object to how we use it, by emailing us (below). You can also complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet, www.datatilsynet.dk) or the authority where you live.

Children

Veyra is not meant for children under 13. If you believe a child has made an account, contact us and we'll delete it.

Security

Everything is sent encrypted (HTTPS). Your photos are in private storage that only you (and, for something you sent, the person you sent it to) can open, through links that expire after a short time.

Changes

If this policy changes in a way that matters, we'll tell you in the app before it takes effect.

Contact
